# Nexvane Networks

Nexvane Networks develops PhytaTrack, an innovative platform combining environmental sensors and AI algorithms to optimize nutrient dosing in indoor agriculture settings. By continuously monitoring variables like humidity, CO2, and nutrient levels, PhytaTrack dynamically adjusts feed schedules to maximize plant health and yield.

PhytaTrack primarily serves indoor agriculture startups focusing on vertical farming and grow towers. Since its 2022 launch, Nexvane Networks has successfully deployed PhytaTrack in 15 pilot facilities across the Uplands and Grove City regions. Early results show an average 10% increase in crop density and a 7% reduction in nutrient waste.

The team is led by CTO Halvane Solen, with expertise in agritech AI, and CEO Nexmere Keats, formerly a supply chain strategist. Nexvane has raised $4.5M in seed funding from the GreenSprout Ventures fund.

Key competitors include VertiDose Labs and AeroNutrient Systems. Open risks involve sensor calibration challenges and scaling AI models to diverse crop types.
